info.title: Discovery
info.description: Allows apps to signal content consumption events back to the platform.

methods.name: Discovery.watched
methods.summary: Notify the platform that content has been partially or completely watched.
methods.description: Notify the platform that content has been partially or completely watched. watchedOn must be ISO 8601 UTC: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ. agePolicy is set by the app to classify the content being reported.

params.name: entityId
params.description: Platform entity ID of the content being reported

params.name: completed
params.description: True if the content was watched to completion

params.name: watchedOn
params.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the content was watched

params.name: agePolicy
params.description: Age policy applied by the app to this content

examples.name: partialWatchAdult
examples.summary: Report partial watch with adult age policy

AgePolicy.title: AgePolicy
AgePolicy.description: Age-rating classification applied by the app to the content being reported.
